_comment: Shared parity fixtures for metadata_template (Python + TypeScript). Python test: CORE/API/tests/test_metadata_template.py. TS test: CORE/WorkflowBuilder/__tests__/metadataTemplate.test.ts. Both MUST produce the exact 'expected.content' string for each input. Adding a case: render it once through the Python side, copy the output in, then add a matching TS test run. DAGs no longer carry process_type or gpu_variants — those live on NodeDefinition; the scheduler picks the queue via select_queue_for_node at enqueue time.
